release_notes: Server page service fixes: SHOUTcast v1 and v2 (plus Fail2Ban, Firewall, Nginx, Cron, MariaDB, Redis) were missing from the services list because ServerManager::getServiceStatus() only detected 7 core services — expanded to 14. Every service now shows clear labeled Start / Stop / Restart buttons (previously an icon-only stop button rendered as a blank square). Service start/stop/restart actions now redirect back to the referring admin page (/admin/server) instead of dumping the admin to /admin/serverconfig. Verified live: all 14 services render, and restarting shoutcast works and returns to /admin/server.
